intent: A bronze-clad barrow guard: a tarnished bronze great-helm crowned with a raised worn rim, four crown points and a pale bone ridge, a bronze cuirass with a bone collar and a bone spine down the back, one great stepped pauldron with a raised fin against a smaller moss-draped shoulder, grave moss creeping in patches over the plate and a moss sash; from the high camera it reads as a broad bronze, bone-crowned, moss-flecked family, apart from the grey iron, brown leather and oxblood studded sets.
requests: A verdigris or patina bronze tone of its own, so the plate reads as metal rather than tan leather under the mood preset.
A bone tone that separates further from tarnished bronze; bone and worn bronze sit close in value at the high camera.
